scripts.prisma:generate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma generate --config=prisma7.config.ts
scripts.prisma:format: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma format --config=prisma7.config.ts
scripts.prisma:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma migrate deploy --config=prisma7.config.ts
scripts.prisma:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma db push --config=prisma7.config.ts
scripts.prisma:reset: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma migrate reset --config=prisma7.config.ts
